consumer_api.const: PROPOSE hioc.classification.validate_classification_result(result,current_inputs,evaluated_at) -> None or fixed safe error. Every use revalidates closed/semantic shape, current input digests/source authority and a newly caller-supplied current time against deadline; elapsed processing never refreshes result time. No stored result is self-authenticating. OPERATOR_DECLARED/EXPLICIT_UNKNOWN require operator_role_evidence matching approved known-config proof; all other states must not fabricate it.

Reject current time>=deadline, future/backward clock or changed input fingerprints. Asset/configuration validity itself has no observation TTL.

unavailable.const: Required inventory invalid => state UNAVAILABLE, valid_until null, devices empty and explicit input failure; never VALID-empty fallback. Empty valid inventory is allowed with corresponding valid input proof.

cadence.const: 2,17,32,47 * * * *; independent composer every900 seconds, no catch-up/retry

consumer.const: Future PE-6 private relationship reader only; no current PE-6 implementation or runtime authorization.

durability.const: PENDING barrier -> exclusive temporary write/file fsync -> one primary replace -> parent fsync -> CONFIRMED sidecar/file/parent barriers. Pre-replace failure preserves prior; post-replace parent failure is INDETERMINATE/WRITE_FAILED, not rollback success.

freshness.const: Inventory age <=2100 seconds with accepted clock rules; output valid_until=min(evaluated_at+1200,inventory.updated+2100). Reject at now>=valid_until and on future/backward clock or changed consumed inventory/source identity.

identifiers.const: Opaque endpoint me_[0-9a-f]{32}; row map_[0-9a-f]{32}; existing strong dev_[0-9a-f]{16}; optional existing same-owner service.

metadata_descriptor_contract.const: Closed schema1.0: dur_[0-9a-f]{32} transaction_id; PENDING requires candidate descriptor and nullable prior confirmed; CONFIRMED requires candidate=null and confirmed descriptor. Descriptors contain only sha256 (64 lowercase hex) and source_revision. Source revision is integer1..9007199254740991; output source_revision may be null for no configured revision. Exact current bytes/domain/revision must match; filenames alone are not confirmation.

missing_and_errors.const: Absent/invalid source may preserve independent local output only with confirmed current output and valid current inputs/schema/time; local null is unavailable, not empty/success. Explicit empty source is known-empty; reject conflicting/duplicate or unknown-owner configured rows per contract.

pe6_responsibility.const: Separately authorized explainable classification/role_suggestion/metadata_quality design and validation; protect operator_role, provenance/privacy/time/rejection and reader-lock lifecycle; no automatic promotion of relationships.

permissions.const: Private parents 0700; regular nonlink single-link files 0600; owner jazofv1, accepted operator UID/GID1000/1000. Future consumer must enforce safety; no permission change here.

producer.const: Approved offline installer writes source; standalone recurring composer writes output; never inventory engine or caller hook.

provenance.const: source_kind configured_mqtt, rule_id declared_endpoint_device_v1; source_id/revision/digest/mapping_id remain private. Local schema unchanged.

public_boundary.const: No raw private source/output/endpoint/topic/credential exposure, public schema change, publication/subscription or inference of MQTT broker health.

reader_lock_note.const: Store.lock() uses nonblocking exclusive flock and may create missing .lock in approved private parent. Existing API is not a filesystem-pure read; future PE-6 must explicitly govern reader/lock lifecycle. Do not call it in PE-5.9.

recovery.const: Only separately approved recertification of exact recorded candidate/prior, fsync without primary replacement or time refresh; unmatched/corrupt bytes stop. Fresh producer recomputation is separate approved action.

relationship_identity.const: mqra_ + SHA256(ASCII canonical JSON array ['configured_mqtt_v1',source_id,endpoint_id,device_id,service_id,'endpoint_to_device']); excludes revision, mapping_id and evaluation.

required_output_confirmation.const: CONFIRMED matching current output digest/domain/revision, closed schema, stable read fingerprint; reject PENDING/missing/malformed/mismatched sidecar.

retention.const: One current primary per domain and bounded sidecar descriptors; no archive/application-payload LKG replay. Stale crash temporaries never adopted; cleanup not authorized.

revision.const: Integer 1..9007199254740991, never bool; approved content changes increment revision; rollback or equal revision with changed content rejected; PENDING recovery floors enforced. No source TTL/observed_at/mtime authority.

source_confirmation.const: For configured VALID require CONFIRMED current source digest/revision and final source/output rechecks under lock. Root VALID alone does not establish all branches valid.

current_production_state.const: UNKNOWN; no current lock/input/store/source/runtime observation made or requested

reader_side_effects.const: Future caller must explicitly authorize existing PE-5 lock lifecycle (may create .lock) and Asset shared lock creation/chmod within approved exact paths; do not call either API on production now. Do not nest locks across subsystems; capture/release/recheck input identity, reject races without retry. No producer, recovery, scheduler or source/output replacement.
